topic: How a room full of phones turned a worthless stock into a fortune
style: Editorial Motion Graphics, accent deep crimson

through_line.name: The card stack
through_line.asset: a stack of monochrome halftone paper cards on a warm cream collage stage, plus a solid deep crimson token slab as the single color-pop
through_line.progression: stack slams down, the giant hand slides the crimson slab out of its base -> crimson strokes fan out and the stack climbs into a tower -> the hand snatches the slab away and the tower stands on an empty notch -> it collapses
through_line.resolution: a dull scattered spread of cards on one side of the cream stage, the crimson slab far off on the other, large and untouched

blocks.vo_line: A stock worth nothing made someone a fortune. It's called a pump and dump, and the scheme is illegal from the first day.
blocks.through_line_state: short and dull, a reserve block snapped out of its base and set aside
shots: SHOT 1 0.0-2.0s WIDE low angle: a short dull stack of flat tokens alone on a vast near-black plane; a hard reserve block snaps out of its base and slides aside (impact beat, cover frame)
SHOT 2 2.0-4.0s ECU high angle: the top face of a single token, dull and scratched, slow push-in
SHOT 3 4.0-6.0s MEDIUM eye level: the reserve block settling apart from the stack, gentle drift
SHOT 4 6.0-8.0s CU low angle: the notch left at the stack's base where the block came out, static
SHOT 5 8.0-10.0s WIDE high angle: the whole plane, small stack and reserve block off to one side, nothing else, slow push-in

blocks.vo_line: Then the phones start. Salespeople work scripted call lists, and every fresh buyer pushes the price higher than the last.
blocks.through_line_state: climbing fast into a tall bright tower as tokens arrive along filaments
shots: SHOT 1 10.0-12.0s CU eye level: a single filament ignites and whips out of frame (impact beat)
SHOT 2 12.0-14.0s WIDE high angle: filaments fan outward across the plane, first three, then a dozen, then a grid, static
SHOT 3 14.0-16.0s ECU low angle: a new token arriving along a filament and landing onto the stack, slow push-in
SHOT 4 16.0-18.0s MEDIUM eye level: the stack climbing fast, brightening as it rises, gentle drift
SHOT 5 18.0-20.0s WIDE low angle: the stack now a tall bright tower against the dark, whip up its full length

blocks.vo_line: It only works on penny stocks: barely any reporting, few shareholders, one push moves everything. At the top, insiders sell.
blocks.through_line_state: at peak height and hollow, then the reserve block slides out from under it
shots: SHOT 1 20.0-22.0s MEDIUM high angle: the tower's tokens revealed as thin and sparse, the structure hollow, static
SHOT 2 22.0-24.0s ECU low angle: one filament pulse runs the tower's height and the whole thing sways from that single push, gentle drift
SHOT 3 24.0-26.0s WIDE eye level: the tower at peak height, bright, filaments still feeding it, slow push-in
SHOT 4 26.0-28.0s CU low angle: at the base, the reserve block slides out in one hard move and exits frame (impact beat)
SHOT 5 28.0-30.0s MEDIUM eye level: the tower standing on nothing, the first tremor running upward, static (CTA lands here)

blocks.vo_line: The hype stops, the price falls, and the last buyers hold it. A stock worth nothing, and someone else's fortune.
blocks.through_line_state: collapsed into a dull scattered spread, the reserve block far off and bright
shots: SHOT 1 30.0-32.0s WIDE low angle: every filament goes dark at once and the tower loses its light (impact beat)
SHOT 2 32.0-34.0s ECU high angle: tokens separating at the top, slow push-in
SHOT 3 34.0-36.0s MEDIUM eye level: the tower collapsing into a scattered dull spread, static
SHOT 4 36.0-38.0s CU low angle: the dull tokens at rest where the tower stood, gentle drift
SHOT 5 38.0-40.0s WIDE high angle: the dull spread on one side, the reserve block far off on the other, large bright and untouched, easing into a settled hold

seo.title: Pump and Dump Explained: How a Worthless Stock Made Millions
seo.description: A stock worth nothing made someone a fortune — here's the illegal scheme behind it. Insiders quietly buy up a cheap penny stock, then rooms of salespeople work scripted call lists to hype it to strangers. It only works on penny stocks: barely any reporting, and so few shareholders that one coordinated push moves the price. At the top the insiders sell everything, the hype stops, and the price falls back to nothing. #Shorts #Stocks #WallStreet #Investing
seo.cta_line: Follow for more market mechanics explained like this.
seo.cover_frame_note: Block 1 shot 1 is the thumbnail: a small dull stack of tokens alone on a vast near-black plane, one hard reserve block snapping out of its base and sliding aside. Two shapes, extreme contrast, no text. Burned caption carries the hook from true 0.0s.
